verdict.rationale: Latham has a dedicated Trademark Litigation practice page that covers prosecuting trademark applications worldwide (registration) and maintaining and policing trademark portfolios (enforcement). It also drafts licenses, co-existence agreements and settlement agreements. The broader 100+ lawyer IP Litigation team, cited by Chambers, handles trademark infringement disputes. Missing for 10: any explicit mention of trademark clearance or search work, a standalone trademark prosecution team separate from litigation, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond firm marketing pages.
